example.title: Dark corrugated boat shed beside the fireboat berth
example.place: Fishermen's Terminal, Seattle, King County, WA

brief: A c. 1980 low gabled boat and gear shed of dark weathered corrugated metal on the quay edge, with a steel stair rail and bins in front and a fireboat moored alongside. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
